name: focus-pet
description: A cozy desktop focus timer where your focused time helps a pixel pet grow.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
